title: Chapter 1445 - 16: Legend (End Of This Volume) _2

Chapter 1445 - 16: Legend (End Of This Volume) _2

Chapter 1445 - 16: Legend (End of This Volume) _2

The Divine Skill 'Return to Origin' is a Physical Body Divine Ability that Lin Yuan awakened in the fourth Origin Source World. This source world is in its nascent initial stage, and Lin Yuan was born within a piece of Innate Divine Stone, becoming the first life to walk between heaven and earth in this source world.

It was in this source world that Lin Yuan established the foundation of the "Innate Five Greats."

The 'Return to Origin' Divine Skill is a refining skill that can return everything to its origin. Theoretically, as long as Lin Yuan is given time, the endless dimensions could all be returned to their origin.

But theory is only theory; to truly restore the entire Chaos Void, one must first have the Time Lords not obstructing, and then not have the will of the Supreme Rule Dao obstructing.

Even so, this divine skill is extremely terrifying.

As for the Divine Skill 'Feathered Ascension,' it is an explosive skill that, when activated, greatly enhances everything about Lin Yuan, to an extent that can be seen as an unlimited enhancement version of the third Divine Skill 'Enhancement.'

The final 'Phantasm Reality Body' is a Physical Body Divine Ability that Lin Yuan awakened in that extraordinarily special source world. The Phantasm Reality Body is a 'passive' Divine Skill, allowing Lin Yuan's physical body to freely switch instantaneously between reality and illusion.

It must be understood that many time lives have comprehended the Origin Dao of reality and illusion, and can transform their physical body between reality and illusion.

Even back in Lin Yuan's home universe, the Magic Jade Tower Master, an Invincible Great Saint, had created similar phantasm reality techniques.

However, to switch instantaneously between phantasm and reality? That is very difficult to achieve, as phantasm and reality are diametrically opposed rule Daos. To switch instantaneously, one must completely fuse these two rule Daos.

And the phantasm that the Phantasm Reality Body converts into is an extremely complete illusion, to the point that even Lin Yuan himself cannot perceive whether he truly exists in that state.

...

The various Physical Body Divine Abilities and the first three of the "Innate Five Greats," together with crossing into the Third Realm and becoming a Time Lord.

Lin Yuan is very much looking forward to his own strength.

First of all, he has certainly stepped into the level of the Legendary Lord.

But to ascertain his specific position among the Legendary Lords, it requires careful confirmation.

"Purple Light, I've just entered the Third Realm, how about we spar a bit?" Lin Yuan looked at the Legendary Lord Purple Light before him.

The easiest way to confirm his specific level of strength is to spar with an opponent of the same level.

Currently, among the eight Legendary Lords in the deepest parts of the Wanwei time space, the Legendary Lord Purple Light is the strongest, having passed the ninety millionth tribulation of the Three Hundred Million Final Tribulations.

He is definitely considered a powerful Legendary Lord.

"Spar a bit?"

The Legendary Lord Purple Light looked at Lin Yuan.

The other seven Legendary Lords had expressions of astonishment.

If these words came from the mouth of another Lord, it would be absurd.

Being newly ascended to the Third Realm and daring to think about sparring with a Legendary Lord? Especially a powerful Legendary Lord?

Isn't this courting death?

Although the Time Lords consolidate past, present, and future timelines, the Legendary Lords cannot completely eradicate everything of a Time Lord, but when facing a Legendary Lord, a Time Lord has only one outcome.

That is to be crushed.

Completely crushed.

But the one who said these words is Lin Yuan.

This future infinitely terrifying Galaxy Lord?

One by one, the Legendary Lords began considering who would win if the two sparred.

It's not that they blindly believe in Lin Yuan's future.

But through sixty thousand years of interaction and exchange, they have come to understand Lin Yuan quite well.

Sixty thousand years ago, while not having stepped into the Third Realm yet, he had already touched the threshold of Legendary Lord.

Now that he has entered the Third Realm, his strength is clearly equated to a Legendary Lord.

"Spar?"

The Legendary Lord Purple Light thought for a moment and smiled: "Alright, but Galaxy, you must be careful."

"I will."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

He also does not want the Legendary Lord Purple Light to hold back, as that would not serve the purpose of verifying his own strength.

"Then I shall begin."

The Legendary Lord Purple Light stood there, raised his right hand, and gently pointed towards Lin Yuan.

With this point, an endless boundless purple light blossomed, penetrating layers upon layers of time and space, covering down towards Lin Yuan.

Of course, since it was merely a spar, the Legendary Lord Purple Light did not go all out, but this strike used seventy percent of his power.

Lin Yuan carefully felt the mysteriousness of the endless purple light.

Not only is Lin Yuan curious about his extent of strength, but the Legendary Lord Purple Light is also very curious, although he is certainly not the match for the future Lin Yuan.

But now?

Legendary Lord Purple Light is still somewhat confident.

"Is this the Chaotic Origin Dao of Purple Light?"

Lin Yuan carefully felt the mysteriousness of the endless purple light.

Every Second Realm Time Life has comprehended their own Chaotic Origin Dao.

Entering the Third Realm will enhance the foundation of one's Chaotic Origin Dao, making the attack power increasingly terrifying, but the foundation remains the Chaotic Origin Dao.

Purple light shines upon the world, Lin Yuan can't escape at all.

However, Lin Yuan never thought of dodging, instead standing there quietly.

Boom——

Purple light pervades, instantly covering everything.

Yet all the purple light penetrates directly through Lin Yuan's physical body, as if Lin Yuan didn't exist at all.

Physical Body Divine Ability — Phantasm Reality Body.

At this moment, Lin Yuan completely transforms into illusion, resembling the vast dimension gaps of the void, bearing many Chaotic Origin Daos.

"Purple light, this slight trick can't touch me." Lin Yuan smiled at the Legendary Lord of Purple Light: "Bring out your trump card move."

"Hmm?" The legendary lord of purple light's expression changed, carefully observing Lin Yuan, feeling incredulous: "How can I not perceive the existence of the galaxy? Obviously standing there, yet I can't feel it, jumping out of space, and not in time, where on earth is it?"

"Galaxy, then I will use a killing move. If you can't hold on, say it immediately." The legendary lord of purple light's eyes suddenly filled with endless purple meaning.

Crackle——

All things in the universe are filled with purple light, even the seven legendary lords watching the battle immediately choose to retreat, unwilling to be enveloped by the purple light.

The terrifying purple light begins to penetrate layer upon layer of space-time again, trying to search for Lin Yuan's exact position.

Lin Yuan is also standing there, letting the legendary lord of purple light search for him, wanting to determine the upper limit of his divine ability.

Dozens of breaths later.

Limitless purple light retreated, and again transformed into the shape of the legendary lord of purple light.

"Galaxy, I can't find you." The legendary lord of purple light sighed.

Though unwilling to admit, yet can't be found means just can't find.

The killing move earlier was the legendary lord of purple light's strongest locked search method, and this move didn't work, which means all the legendary lord's methods are ineffective.

"Galaxy, it's your turn."

The legendary lord of purple light looked at Lin Yuan and said.

Not being able to find Lin Yuan doesn't mean defeat.

Mainly to see if Lin Yuan can pose a threat to him.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, his aura subtly changed, the powers of Tai Yi, Tai Chu, and Tai Shi within the Innate Five Great collided and intertwined continuously, plus the divine skill 'Feather Ascension' empowerment.

For a moment, Lin Yuan's aura became extremely terrifying, even though he did nothing, his own space-time began to quickly vanish.

"What is this?"

The legendary lord of purple light took a deep breath.

After observing for an instant, the legendary lord of purple light immediately spoke: "No need for sparring, galaxy, you win."

The legendary lord of purple light clearly felt that the killing move Lin Yuan activated at the last moment had already threatened him.

Unable to attack Lin Yuan, yet the opponent's move could threaten himself.

Apparently, the outcome is determined, only a matter of sooner or later.

"Purple Light admits defeat?"

The seven legendary lords watching from afar exchanged glances, their hearts difficult to calm.

They knew Purple Light's strength, even self rendee was not a match, ordinary legendary lords certainly weren't his opponents.

"Just sparring, there's no real win or lose."

Lin Yuan responded immediately, since it's sparring, real killing moves definitely wouldn't be employed.

Lin Yuan never thought of defeating the Legendary Lord of Purple Light, just determining the specific extent of his own strength.

"Galaxy, your current power likely exceeds that of a legendary lord who has undergone a billion calamities." The Legendary Lord of Purple Light said.

"A billion calamities legendary lord?"

The seven legendary lords afar inhaled sharply upon hearing.

A billion calamities is a threshold among the legendary lords, only by crossing this threshold can one dare to aspire to see the end of the path to transcendence.

...

...

...
